name: Roland RD-300NX
description: Roland RD-300NX SuperNATURAL stage piano: the system blocks and the whole temporary Live Set (common, song/rhythm, chorus, reverb, MFX, and each of three layers' internal and external zone, tone and piano settings), from the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: RD-300NX MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Dec. 10, 2010)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from RD-300NX_MI.pdf (sha256 8f50e9d4203f33b69e5ec857c1bc5ec1c7e1313ab7c8a9fbd4159ddb46767141). Model ID 00 00 51, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Layers 1-3 are the offset table's "(Layer: 01)" to "(Layer: 03)": Internal Layer 10 00 30 00-10 00 32 00, External Layer 10 00 40 00-10 00 42 00, Tone 10 01 00 00-10 01 02 00, Piano 10 02 00 00/10 02 20 00/10 02 40 00 (p9). Live Set Common names three keyboard zones UPPER1, UPPER2 and LOWER (Slider Assign, p11) and Internal Layer three Control Slider Switches for them; the address map does not say which layer is which zone, so the groups keep its numbers.

Model ID: the address map (p9), the RQ1 byte list (p6), the transmitted DT1 byte list (p9) and both worked examples (p14-15) give 00 00 51. The received DT1 byte list (p6) prints 00 00 50, the RD-700NX's, and the prose above it (p6) "00H 00H 2BH", the RD-700GX's. The profile uses 00 00 51.

System Favorite Live Set (p10) prints one row pair, "Favorite1 - 24 Live Set Category" (00 06) and "Favorite1 - 24 Live Set Number" (00 07, three nibbles), then ":" to a last Number at 01 13. Only that first pair is laid out (as favorite1LiveSetCategory/Number). At four bytes a favorite the last Number at 01 13 and the Total Size 00 00 01 16 make 36 favorites, not 24 (24 would end at 00 66); the manual does not say which is right, so favorites 2 onward are not addressed.

Internal Layer prints "Modulation Switch" and "Bender Switch" twice (00 0F/00 10, among the controller switches with Damper, FC1, FC2, the sliders and S1/S2; and 00 1A/00 19, among the received-message switches with Bank Select, Program Change, Volume, Pan, Hold-1 and Expression). They are numbered 1 and 2 in printed order.

Live Set Piano MicroTune 1-128 (00 0B-04 07, four nibbles each) are 128 per-note tuning values (one per note number, it appears; the manual prints only the rows), beside Stretch Tune Type OFF/PRST/USER.

Display ranges one step off their wire ranges, kept as printed: Live Set Tone's Cutoff, Resonance, Attack, Decay and Release Time (00 0A-00 0E, p13) are 0-127 over "-63 - +63" (the External Layer's matching values print "-64 - +63"); Slider Assign (UPPER2) and (LOWER) (Live Set Common 00 47, 00 49, p11) are (0 - 133) over "0 - 134".

Value lists that do not count out stay numbers with the manual's line as their description: System V-Link Mode prints "BANK/PC.NOTE" for two values (p10); Live Set Common's Sound Focus Assign is (0 - 31) over seven labels (p11); the FC, System FC and Slider Assign lists elide their CC numbers.
Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): layer1.piano, layer2.piano, layer3.piano.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the sliders, pedals and S1/S2 transmit as Control Change (Data Transmission, p7-8) is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: chorus, reverb and MFX parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.presets: none: neither manual prints a Bank Select table for Live Sets; Program Change is received as "prog.1 - prog.128" and Bank Select as "bank.1 - bank.16384" with no list of what they select, so no preset banks are listed
coverage.notModelled: nothing in the address map is left out: System (00 00 00 00) and the Temporary Live Set (10 00 00 00) are laid out whole. Of the System Favorite Live Set block only Favorite 1's two rows are addressable (see notes)
